title: Urban Transport and the Case for Car-Free City Centres
prompt: In many cities, local authorities are considering banning private cars from the central business district in order to reduce congestion and improve air quality. Some people argue that such a ban would harm local businesses and restrict personal freedom, while others believe the long-term benefits for residents and the environment outweigh these concerns. Discuss the advantages of introducing a car-free zone in a city centre, and explain which advantage you consider most significant. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为学术类 Task 2 议论文练习。请围绕“城市中心无车区”的利与弊展开讨论，重点分析其优势，并明确指出你认为最重要的一项优势。所有场景与数据均为模拟，并非官方雅思试题。建议先用 5 分钟构思立场与两个分论点，再用 35 分钟左右完成至少 250 词的完整文章。
